# OriginSuperOETHArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/OriginSuperOETHArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
OriginSuperOETHArk

Ark contract for managing ETH/WETH deposits into Origin ETH protocol

Implements strategy for depositing into Origin ETH, withdrawing tokens, and tracking yield


## State Variables
### originETH
The Origin ETH contract this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IOriginETH public immutable originETH
```


### arm
The ARM contract this Ark interacts with


```solidity
IArm public immutable arm
```


### originETHVault
The Origin ETH vault address


```solidity
IOriginETHVault public immutable originETHVault
```


### withdrawalRequestId
The request ID for the withdrawal


```solidity
uint256 public withdrawalRequestId
```

### constructor

```solidity
constructor(address _originETH, ArkParams memory _params) ArkWithWithdrawalRequest(_params, 15);
```

```solidity

```
**Returns**

|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|The total balance of underlying assets held in the vault for this Ark, including any pending withdrawal amounts|

### withdrawUsingSwap

Withdraws assets from the Ark using a swap

This function is only callable by the keeper


```solidity
function withdrawUsingSwap(uint256 amount, bytes calldata data) external onlyKeeper nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of assets to withdraw|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to pass to the swap (router and swap calldata)|


### requestWithdrawal

Requests a withdrawal of underlying assets from the Ark.

This function is only callable by the keeper.

**Parameters**

|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of underlying asset to request a withdrawal for.|

### _withdrawableTotalAssets

Internal function to get the total assets that are withdrawable

Returns the sum of the direct asset balance and the redeemable amount from Origin ETH
limited by the ARM balance


```solidity
function _withdrawableTotalAssets() internal view override returns (uint256 withdrawableAssets);
```
**Returns**

|----|----|-----------|
|`withdrawableAssets`|`uint256`|Assets that can be immediately withdrawn|

### _harvest

Internal function for harvesting rewards

This function is a no-op as Origin ETH auto-compounds the rewards


```solidity
function _harvest(bytes calldata)
    internal
    pure
    override
    returns (address[] memory rewardTokens, uint256[] memory rewardAmounts);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`||

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardTokens`|`address[]`|The addresses of the reward tokens (empty array in this case)|
|`rewardAmounts`|`uint256[]`|The amounts of the reward tokens (empty array in this case)|

## Errors
### AssetMismatch
Error thrown when the asset in ArkParams doesn't match WETH


```solidity
error AssetMismatch();
```

### InvalidOriginETHAddress
Error thrown when an invalid Origin ETH address is provided


```solidity
error InvalidOriginETHAddress();
```

### InvalidOriginETHVaultAddress
Error thrown when an invalid Origin ETH vault address is provided


```solidity
error InvalidOriginETHVaultAddress();
```
